quest.title: Hmm? Natlan?
quest.description: You are accosted by someone at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame...

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: ...Was this question too easy after all?

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Oh, my apologies. I was just thinking aloud, didn't even notice you there.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Allow me to extend my greetings. I am Keita, of the Masters of the Night-Wind. I am currently an apprentice here, in charge of file management.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what were you thinking about?

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Ah... Just a few simple questions regarding Natlan's past, present, and future. Completely unworthy of discussion.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Judging by your appearance, you seem to be a traveler from afar. I can tell that your many friendships are deep, and your knowledge broad...

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Should you be willing, you could try your hand at some of the questions I've already recorded.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: The answers to these questions lie within your journey — past, present, and future.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I am.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Hmm, resolute and decisive. Quite commendable.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe in a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Yes, it is not urgent. I can wait.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Are you ready to answer those questions?

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: The sounds of the Children of Echoes' hammers ring out ceaselessly among the peaks. They are superlative smiths and tenacious warriors. Even the strongest stone cannot slow their march.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: My question is: Who are the companions of the Children of Echoes? What is their true name?

response.speaker: Keita
response.text: Indeed, completely flawless. Not a single error.

response.speaker: Keita
response.text: Hmm... A minor mistake. Worthy of further consideration.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: You have seen those whose entire body is a vibrant green, those who dart atop cliffs and leap amongst the trees, the ones known as Yumkasaurs, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: My question is: What is the name of the tribe where the Yumkasaurs live?

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Natlan has a certain thing. It can be used for forging, for the making of records... and it even has different states. Sometimes it is liquid, others solid. Moreover, this thing exists only in Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: My question is: What's the name of that thing?

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Above the flowing springs, on the edge of the crashing waves, there lives a tribe known as the People of the Springs. They are cheerful, kind people, lovers of music, gatherings, and hot springs. Staying with them is sure to bring gladness.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: My question is: Who are the companions of the People of the Springs? What is their true name?

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: In Natlan, phlogiston may be found in many things — yes, even within certain plants.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: My question is: In Natlan, there is a type of mushroom that contains phlogiston. What is its name?

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: In Natlan, phlogiston may be found in many things — yes, even in some plants.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: My question is: In Natlan, there is a type of flower that contains phlogiston. What is its name?

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Well then, please continue to answer the next question.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Hmm, the final question.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Your answers yet betray errors and flawed understanding, and are far from perfect...

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Hmm... You still have much to experience here in Natlan, it seems.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Fret not. The future and past shall become the answers to the present.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Your answers are flawless, perfect, with not a single error.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: May wisdom accompany you throughout your journey.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: ...Perhaps my questions are simply too easy?

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: ...You have the courage to take on the questions. That alone is praiseworthy.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Please continue to journey through Natlan. I am sure you will find more answers as you go.
